idea-plugin.name: kUML
idea-plugin.description:
kUML — Kotlin-based UML & C4 modelling

Adds first-class IntelliJ support for kUML diagram scripts (*.kuml.kts):

  • Recognises *.kuml.kts as a custom Kotlin script kind via the org.jetbrains.kotlin.scriptDefinitionsProvider extension point.
  • Syntax highlighting and structural navigation are inherited from IntelliJ's Kotlin language support — no custom lexer or parser.
  • Default imports for the kUML DSL (dev.kuml.core.dsl.*, dev.kuml.uml.dsl.*, dev.kuml.c4.dsl.*) are visible to the editor, so unqualified classDiagram { ... }, c4Model { ... }, and friends resolve without explicit imports.
  • Distinct file icon for kUML scripts.

Rendering, code generation, OCL validation, and state-machine simulation are provided by the kuml CLI and the dev.kuml Gradle plugin — this IDE plugin is intentionally minimal and stays out of the render pipeline.

Without the Kotlin plugin (WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, Rider, CLion, DataGrip, RubyMine): the plugin still loads and provides the kUML file icon and the live split-view SVG preview. Script recognition, completion, structure view, folding, rename and inline diagnostics require the Kotlin plugin and activate automatically once it is installed.

Project page: https://kuml.dev.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.20.0

  • org.jetbrains.kotlin is now an optional dependency: on IDEs without the Kotlin plugin (WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, Rider, CLion, DataGrip, RubyMine) the plugin still loads and provides the file icon and the live split-view SVG preview. Script recognition, completion, structure view, folding, rename and inline diagnostics move to a config-file fragment (META-INF/kuml-kotlin-support.xml) that only loads when the Kotlin plugin is present.

0.8.0

  • K2-Kompatibilität: Plugin läuft wieder in IntelliJ 2024.x+ mit aktivem K2-Frontend.
  • Versions-Alignment: Plugin-Version folgt dem kUML-Monorepo.

0.4.1

  • Code completion für kUML-DSL-Top-Level-Funktionen (42 Items).
  • Rename Refactoring (Shift+F6) für DSL-Element-Namen.
  • Live Templates (12 Templates).

0.3.0

  • Code Folding für DSL-Lambda-Blöcke.

0.2.0

  • Live-SVG Split-View, Structure View, External Annotator + Quick Fixes.

0.1.0

  • Initiale Version: Script-Definition Provider, Dateityp-Registrierung, Datei-Icon.
